NCANTATION CONSULTING  ·  A PMA

Ncantation Consulting is a private membership association that introduces its accredited members to independent, unaffiliated offerors of oil & gas, cannabis, biotechnology, and saltwater disposal well opportunities. Ncantation Consulting does not itself offer, sell, recommend, or manage securities, and nothing on this page is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security. Membership and any introduction are subject to verification of accredited investor status.
